- [**Le Doubs Bike**\\
\\
RouteLe Locle\\
\\
A wonderful and sporty trail through the Neuchâtel Mountains: the best way to discover the musts and typical points of view of the area. A chance to admire the beautiful Lake Moron, the Saut-du-Doubs waterfall and Lake Brenets.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/le-doubs-bike/)

\\
AccommodationGoumois](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/accommodations/hotel-du-doubs/)
- [**Hôtel du Doubs**\\

AccommodationGoumois](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/accommodations/hotel-du-doubs-1/)
- [**Saut du Doubs**\\
\\
ExperienceLac des Brenets\\
\\
The water of the river Doubs, which has been dammed up by landslide debris, forms the four kilometer long, but only 200 meter wide, winding Lac des Brenets. The 27 meter high Doubs Falls are located at its end. The Falls can be reached on foot or by passenger boat.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/saut-du-doubs/)
- [**Clos du Doubs Bike**\\
\\
RouteSaint-Ursanne](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/clos-du-doubs-bike/)
- [**Vallée du Doubs Bike**\\
\\
RouteMontfaucon](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/vallee-du-doubs-bike/)
- [**Au fil du Doubs, Stage 4/4**\\
\\
RouteSoubey\\
\\
15 kilometres of meditative hiking pleasure and one of Switzerland's most beautiful "water trails" run between Soubey and St-Ursanne.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/au-fil-du-doubs-95_04/)
- [**Hôtel-Restaurant du Doubs**\\
\\
RestaurantGoumois\\
\\
The Hotel-Restaurant du Doubs proposes you to taste its specialities in a warm setting, just a step away from the Franco-Swiss river.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/food-wine/restaurant/hotel-restaurant-du-doubs/)
- [**Au fil du Doubs, Stage 2/4**\\
\\
RouteGoumois\\
\\
It's hard to imagine just how much industry (glazier’s workshops, sawmills, mills) there was on the Doubs 200 years ago. Today only a few signs of this intense industrial activity remain, as in Le Theusseret shortly before Goumois, the finish of the second stage.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/au-fil-du-doubs-95_02/)
- [**Canoeing on the Doubs**\\
\\
OfferSaint-UrsanneFebruary 28, 2027\\
\\
Paddle on the calm waters of the Doubs and discover the region from a different perspective, at the pace of nature.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/planning/offers/canoeing-on-the-doubs/)
- [**Hotel & Restaurant du Doubs**\\
\\
RestaurantGoumois\\
\\
In the restaurant, on the terrace, and in the bar, the Hôtel du Doubs offers you its culinary specialties: Trout with fresh herbs, frog legs and deep-fried carp fillets.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/food-wine/restaurant/hotel-du-doubs-de-goumois/)
- [**Au fil du Doubs, Stage 3/4**\\
\\
RouteGoumois\\
\\
Fishermen are often met along the path. The Doubs has a unique fish population including the authentic Doubs trout with black stripes, barbel, grayling, pike and of course the elusive apron, also known as Roi du Doubs.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/au-fil-du-doubs-95_03/)
- [**Au fil du Doubs, Stage 1/4**\\
\\
RouteLes Brenets\\
\\
Picturesque and rugged ravines that could almost be called fiords open up after Les Brenets. Polished by natural forces, the rock faces have the shape of a human face and the head of a legendary monster. The trail leads to the Saut du Doubs, a spectacular, 27m high waterfall.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/au-fil-du-doubs-95_01/)
- [**Au fil du Doubs**\\
\\
RouteLes Brenets\\
\\
This hike does full justice to its name. The trail leads from Les Brenets near La Chaux-de-Fonds to St. Ursanne, almost always alongside the River Doubs and crossing the Doubs Regional National Park from west to east.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/au-fil-du-doubs/)
- [**Des Franches-Montagnes au Doubs**\\
\\
RouteLe Noirmont](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/des-franches-montagnes-au-doubs/)
- [**Hôtel Les Rives du Doubs**\\
\\
AccommodationLes Brenets](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/accommodations/hotel-les-rives-du-doubs/)
- [**Hiking holidays Au fil du Doubs**\\
\\
OfferLes BrenetsMarch 19, 2027\\
\\
Switzerland's most beautiful secret: Fjord landscapes, waterfalls and Jura specialties – the Doubs border river is probably one of Switzerland’s best-kept secrets.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/planning/offers/hiking-holidays-au-fil-du-doubs/)
- [**Restaurant d'escapade au bord du Doubs**\\
\\
RestaurantGoumois\\
\\
Restaurant in the Doubs nature reserve, between chute and cascades, along the hiking trails.\\
Spécialité de Truites fraiches du vivier et produits locaux uniquement.\\
Prix de la plus belle Terrasse du jura 2018.\\
Décoration typical of the 1920s.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/food-wine/restaurant/restaurant-descapade-au-bord-du-doubs/)
- [**JEANNE CHEVALIER & GUILLAUME PERRET : DES FRANCHES-MONTAGNES AU DOUBS, À QUATRE YEUX (1...**\\
\\
EventSaignelégierNovember 15, 2026\\
\\
L'exposition Des Franches-Montagnes au Doubs, à quatre yeux (1980-2026) vise à croiser le regard photographique de Jeanne Chevalier avec celui de Guillaume Perret.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/events/jeanne-chevalier-guillaume-perret-des-franchesmontagnes-au-doubs-a-quatre-yeux-1/)
- [**Trans Swiss Trail, Stage 2/32**\\
\\
RouteSaint-Ursanne\\
\\
The Doubs is a moody, fascinating river. The hike along the south bank from St-Ursanne to La Charbonnière is almost always along nature trails, close to the shimmering, blue-green waters. Many dragonflies and birds inhabit the river banks.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/trans-swiss-trail-2_02/)
